rent.reason: A button requests a rent without selecting a bikeId through an App.
Firmware checks bike state inside rent-request handling; it has no checkAvailable() message.
Firmware replies reserved after adding a reservation, rather than replying Available.
Firmware sends an unlock frame from SensorNode to ActuatorNode instead of Station to Bike.
Firmware emits the started frame from ActuatorNode, not Rental to App.
Firmware does not show the user an unlocked or ride-started message.

return.reason: A long button press requests return; firmware has no App message named returnBike().
Firmware locks only after simulated payment confirmation, not directly after docking.
Firmware calls Rental::end() after simulated payment confirmation, while UML ends the rental before charging.
Mega firmware has no PaymentService and performs no charge; payment is simulated.
Mega firmware has no PaymentService reply; a button simulates confirmation instead.
Firmware emits the receipt from ActuatorNode to SensorNode, rather than from Rental to App.
